title: Purple Flame Warrior Poses
description: Three side-by-side views of a dark-skinned female warrior with short white hair, wearing a revealing purple and white tribal outfit with silver accents and bandages on her arms and legs. She is surrounded by swirling purple mystical flames or energy, shown in a crouching pose on the left, a dynamic mid-air pose in the center, and a combat stance on the right.
